executor: human generation executor (founder) or a separate automation -- never the Claude PS5 session
intended_provider: chatgpt_handoff (pipeline emits the locked prompt; founder returns the image)
text_in_image: none -- overlay copy is burned in afterwards by PS-05
report_back: save the image at output.expected_path; the next coordinator run detects it and queues visual QA -- nothing else to report
ps5_forbidden: call or trigger an image-generation API or UI
